breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the error by stating 'Set end slopes to zero at both supports due to symmetric loading' and 'Verify that the zero end slope assumption is consistent with the symmetric loading condition.' This directly mirrors the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth omits this constraint entirely because a simply supported beam under uniform load rotates at the supports — symmetry only makes the slopes equal and opposite, not zero. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency.
